headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Milwaukee Brewers secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Misiorowski pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 11. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The Brewers also dominated the Cardinals in a 10-2 victory, with Robert Gasser pitching 7.2 innings and striking out 4.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Samad Taylor of the San Diego Padres, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain. Other players on the injured list include Marco Raya of the Minnesota Twins, Endy Rodríguez of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Lou Trivino III of the Philadelphia Phillies, Jonah Cox of the San Francisco Giants, Austin Warren of the New York Mets, Byron Buxton of the Minnesota Twins, and Konnor Griffin of the Pittsburgh Pirates.

The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets for cash, while also trading RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and the Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Matthew Boyd earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall to Tigers in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers took down the Athletics 6-2, securing a decisive victory. Colt Keith led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Giants 10-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants in a lopsided 10-0 victory. Impact hitters for the Blue Jays included Nathan Lukes, Vladimir Guerrero Jr., George Springer, Daulton Varsho, and Kazuma Okamoto.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Samad Taylor on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres left fielder Samad Taylor has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash.
